headline: Approved personnel recommendations including three new hires and one retirement, 3-0
summary: The committee reviewed district staffing, including 63 job openings and interim coverage plans. It approved personnel recommendations for new hires Bailey Allen, Kate Murphy, and Abigail Reardon, and noted the retirement of Victoria Perry effective August 31, 2026.

decision_evidence.quote: Ms. Raymond moved, seconded by Ms. Lewis, to approve the Personnel Recommendations dated 9-14-26. Motion passes 3-0.

HUMAN RESOURCES COMMITTEE MEETING 
MONDAY, SEPTEMBER 14, 2026 
NHS NORTH BOARD ROOM 
 
A meeting of the Human Resources Committee was held at NHS North on Monday, September 14, 2026.  Ms. 
Giglio called the meeting to order at 5:54 pm. 
 
Present:  Ms. Giglio, Ms. Raymond, Ms. Lewis, and Ms. Lopez 
 
Also Present: Channel 99 Videographer, Mr. Bowse, Dr. Andrade, Dr. Scarpati, and Mr. O’Rourke 
 
 
HR Update 
• The district reported 63 openings: 11 teachers, 3 school psychologists, 2 speech-language pathologists, 15 
behavior technicians, 36 paraprofessionals, 14 food service positions, 11 facilities operations positions, 8 
crossing guards, 4 administrative positions, and 2 secretaries. 
• Elementary vacancies include eight positions: one fifth-grade position at Birch Hill, one kindergarten 
position at New Searles, four intensive-needs special education positions, and two other special education 
positions at Amherst Street and Main Dunstable. 
• High school vacancies include two special education positions and one math position. Current math 
teachers are covering the math opening. 
• A Pennichuck secretary accepted an offer, reducing the secretary vacancies from three to two. 
 
Interim Coverage 
• Contractors cover the intensive-needs special education positions, while behavior specialists temporarily 
backfill three of the four positions. 
• Existing special education staff are covering vacancies at Amherst Street and Main Dunstable and 
handling related IEP responsibilities. 
• Food service staffing is redistributed among schools as needed. The exact breakdown of the 14 vacancies 
was not available. 
• Paraprofessional coverage remains somewhat below full staffing, although the 36 openings do not 
represent 36 contractors. 
• Recruitment continues through Ed Jobs New Hampshire, Top School Jobs, K-12 Jobs, Handshake, 
and SchoolSpring.
